notes.title: New Update
notes.content:
Performance and stability improvements (things should be way better now).

Should have solved all the fiddly physics bugs and puzzle logic issues.

Internal rewrite to bring it up to date with latest SteamVR/Unity versions.

Internal Refectoring to a much cleaner system for handling things and logic internally.

Should be trivial to start adding way more content now and expand out to other rooms.
